title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
abstract: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.

summary.core_contribution: 提出一种结构条件视频渲染器SolarRenderer，通过两个轻量LoRA适配冻结的MiniMax-H3 33B骨干网络，实现仅需四步的高效渲染，并具备对多种未见结构表示的强泛化能力。
summary.method: 将结构视频以纯文本描述、无类型标识的方式输入骨干网络原生的参考通路，使单一控制LoRA可跟随任意结构表示；从预训练的四步LoRA出发，采用结构引导的分布匹配实现四步渲染；并设计块因果变体以支持流式实时渲染768p视频；训练数据为从游戏引擎、模拟器和YouTube构建的136K帧对齐片段语料。
summary.findings: 四步渲染比50步采样快12.3倍且保持所学控制能力；在分布内测试集和包含16种结构表示的泛化基准上均达到最先进水平，并成功泛化到11种未见表示，包括姿态骨架、手绘草图和点云。

title: Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation
abstract: Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Beyond these empirical gains, the learned residual-space dynamics reveal where adaptation capacity is concentrated within the diffusion model. Restricting adaptation to the identified layers by our method preserves nearly the same performance while reducing the number of trainable parameters by up to 72\%, demonstrating that residual-space dynamics can identify the layers that contribute most to continual concept personalization and directly guide more parameter-efficient adaptation.

summary.title_zh: 通过残差空间适配实现扩散模型中的持续概念个性化
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出将残差空间适配扩展到预训练扩散模型的随机适配过程中，以解决概念按顺序到达时的持续个性化问题，在保持近乎零遗忘的同时实现了最高的概念保真度。
summary.method: 作者将残差空间适配方法应用于预训练扩散模型的随机适配过程，使模型能够持续学习新概念（主体、物体或风格）而不干扰已学概念。通过学习到的残差空间动态分析适配容量在扩散模型中的分布位置，并据此限制适配层以提升参数效率。
summary.findings: 该方法在竞争性持续个性化方法中实现了最高的概念保真度，同时保持近乎零遗忘。残差空间动态揭示了适配容量集中于扩散模型的特定层，仅在这些层进行适配可将可训练参数减少高达72%而性能几乎不变，表明残差空间动态能有效识别对持续概念个性化贡献最大的层并指导参数高效适配。

title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
abstract: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.

summary.title_zh: Code2Video-Compass：面向T2V、I2V和V2V的通用代码视频生成综合基准
summary.core_contribution: 提出了首个覆盖文本到视频（T2V）、图像到视频（I2V）和视频到视频（V2V）三种输入模态的通用代码视频生成基准，包含2104个任务和双层评估框架，系统评估了15个多模态大模型在完整视频创作上的能力。
summary.method: 构建了涵盖10个类别、24个子类型和三个复杂度维度（构建、动态动画、状态依赖）的2104个任务，任务来源于文本指令和视觉参考，并衍生出对应的T2V、I2V和V2V任务。提出双层评估框架，结合12个客观指标（操作性能、视频质量、文本-视频对齐、参考保真度）和5个主观指标（由MLLM评判指令遵循和整体视频质量）。对来自9个模型家族的15个最新专有和开源多模态大模型进行了广泛评估。
summary.findings: 即使领先的模型在可靠生成高质量、符合文本和视觉要求的完整视频方面仍面临挑战，且性能通常随着构建、动态动画和状态依赖复杂度的增加而下降。该基准有望推动可靠、连贯、可控的代码视频生成发展。

title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
abstract: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses $\sim$10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.

summary.title_zh: AnyGameRenderer：跨游戏实体一致的生成式渲染及实体级基准
summary.core_contribution: 提出AnyGameRenderer，一种视频到视频的生成式渲染器，能将AI智能体生成的粗糙游戏画面转化为高质量视觉效果，同时严格保持布局、相机及每个实体的位置与时间一致性，并构建了实体级评测基准。
summary.method: 以普通视频作为游戏状态输入，无需引擎G-buffer、逐对象类别标签或低模代理，灰度块、彩色图元、语义图和线框均可作为输入。通过LoRA微调33B的参考视频条件视频生成模型MiniMax-H3 ref2va实现。训练数据约1万对片段，来自三个来源：GEAR工具导出的38个智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据、Unreal Engine中程序化控制人群与实体规模的双流渲染数据，以及通过3D框检测重建配对真实游戏录像。
summary.findings: 在包含59个留出案例、753个实体的实体级基准上，相比基座模型，AnyGameRenderer的时间匹配率从50.9%提升至62.9%，漏检数量变化率从34.7%降至21.3%，幻觉或未渲染实体更少，实体对应保持能力显著更优。

title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.

summary.title_zh: 直接强制：面向少步自回归文本到视频生成的单阶段训练配方
summary.core_contribution: 提出Direct Forcing单阶段训练框架，将因果适配与分布匹配统一到一个训练阶段中，无需单独的初始化阶段或在线扩散分数监督，即可从双向预训练视频模型直接学习少步自回归视频生成器。
summary.method: 该方法将参考视频同时用作历史延续的配对样本和自生成rollout的目标分布。因果延续对齐（Causal Continuation Alignment）在参考历史条件下学习配对的时空对应关系；Rollout分布匹配（Rollout Distribution Matching）利用最大均值差异（MMD）对齐自生成视频与参考视频的表示分布。动态梯度平衡（Dynamic Gradient Balancing）在训练过程中自适应调整两种信号的相对梯度贡献。从双向Wan2.1-1.3B模型出发，仅用250次更新即学到四步自回归生成器。
summary.findings: Direct Forcing在250次更新内实现四步自回归生成，取得84.63的VBench总分和86.01的质量分，且无需单独初始化阶段或在线扩散分数监督。消融实验验证了动态梯度平衡的有效性，并揭示了不同的表示偏好：更深层特征有利于因果延续对齐，而中间层特征对rollout分布匹配效果更佳。
